post.summary: Run a Sync (owner only) and return what the web toast shows.
post.description: Re-Syncs the caller's designated Studies (and USCF, coach Studies, analysis) and atomically swaps the store, exactly like the web Sync button. No request body. Status mapping of data.refresh(): success -> 200 with status success; already_running -> 200 with status already_running (the web shows a warning toast, not a failure, and the in-flight Sync will still land), with empty lists; demo -> 403 forbidden with the refresh error as the message ('Demo mode is read-only; Sync is disabled.'), because demo mode, like a guest, may not write; error (Lichess unreachable, no Games found, store never initialized, enrichment raised) -> 502 sync_failed with the refresh error as the message, and the current data stays untouched. A guest (auth.can_write() false) gets 403 forbidden before any Sync runs.

200.description: The Sync completed, or one was already running.

502.description: The Sync failed (error code sync_failed); the server keeps showing the current data.

SyncPayload.description: The Sync toast and celebration banner as data. On already_running every list is [] and the freshness fields describe the data currently shown. Source: shell.py run_sync -> data.refresh (RefreshOutcome: status, new_games, failures), shell._describe_new_games, shell._per_source_freshness (data.synced_at, data.uscf_synced_at, data.uscf_unavailable_since), pgn_stats_core.milestone_deltas, data.get_new_achievements.

status.description: success: the store was swapped ('Sync complete'); already_running: a Sync was in progress, nothing was done ('Sync already running').

new_games.description: Games whose ChapterURL was not in the previous Sync, in store order. [] means 'No new games. Everything is already up to date.'

milestones.description: Personal bests the new Games set (the celebration banner), comparing the pre-Sync and post-Sync stores.

new_achievements.description: Official USCF achievements (norms, awards) first seen by this Sync. [] on the very first recording and whenever USCF was unreachable.

failures.description: Designated Studies this Sync could not fetch; the Sync still succeeded on the rest. The web toast lists their IDs ('couldn't fetch: ...').

synced_at.description: When the last successful Lichess Sync completed. The toast renders it as 'synced X ago'.

uscf_synced_at.description: When USCF data was last fetched; null when USCF is not configured or never reached.

uscf_unavailable_since.description: 'USCF unavailable since <time>' when the USCF data shown is the cache of an earlier Sync, else null.

SyncNewGame.description: One new Game, as the toast lists it ('vs Edwards (Win)'). Tap opens the Game.

SyncMilestone.description: One personal best broken by this Sync.

kind.description: peak_rating: a new highest rating; win_streak: a new longest win Streak (in Games); giant_kill: a win over the highest-rated opponent yet.

old.description: The previous best (a rating, or a Streak length for win_streak).

new.description: The new best, same unit as old.

description.description: The celebration text, e.g. 'New peak rating: 1571 (was 1545)'.

SyncAchievement.description: One newly recognized official USCF achievement. The web celebrates it as 'Official USCF achievement: <title> (<rated_event_name>)'.

rated_event_id.description: The Rated Event it was earned at; "" when unknown.

SyncFailure.description: One designated Study the Sync could not fetch.
